name: AI Integration & Workflow Automation Strategy
description: Strategic advisory for businesses looking to leverage Generative AI and automation. I assess your current workflows, identify high-impact opportunities for AI integration, and design a strategic roadmap for implementation. This includes selecting the right AI tools (like Copilot, Gemini, and other agentic systems), defining spec-driven development processes, and ensuring your team is equipped to build and maintain AI-powered solutions efficiently.

name: Cloud-Native Architecture & Design
description: Architectural design for building scalable, resilient, and cost-effective applications on AWS. I work with your team to design microservices architectures, define practices for serverless computing, and create a blueprint for your cloud infrastructure aligned with your long-term business goals and security requirements.

name: Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD Pipeline Implementation
description: I build and configure cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines using modern DevOps practices. This service includes writing Terraform code to manage AWS resources and setting up automated CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions for reliable, repeatable deployments.

name: Custom CLI & Automation Tool Development
description: Development of custom command-line interface (CLI) tools and automation scripts in Go to address your team's specific challenges. Whether for automating deployments, managing infrastructure, or simplifying complex workflows, I build cross-platform tools that improve engineering efficiency.

name: REST API & Microservices Implementation
description: Back-end development focused on building secure, well-documented REST APIs and microservices. Using Go and modern frameworks, I implement services designed for scalability and maintainability.

name: Full-Stack Web Development
description: End-to-end web application development using modern technologies. From front-end interfaces with React and TypeScript to back-end systems in Go or Python, deployed on AWS infrastructure.
